muy mala atencion, deja mucho que decir, una pena, hasta para ir al baño puso mala cara el playero, espero que si alguno de los propietarios lea esto, les explique a sus dependiente lo importante que es tratar con respeto y con una sonrisa al cliente, y no hablo solo por, xq de la mismo forma trato a una pareja mayor que tambien cargaron en el surtidor del otro lado

Very poor service, it leaves much to be desired, a real shame. Even when I went to the bathroom, the attendant gave me a dirty look. I hope that if any of the owners read this, they explain to their employees how important it is to treat customers with respect and a smile. And I'm not just talking about one person, because he treated an elderly couple who also filled up at the pump on the other side the same way.
